item.title: Rail passengers face second day of disruption across north-west England
item.summary: Problems after power failure at regional signalling centre likely to continue until noon on Friday Business live – latest updates Rail passengers are facing a second day of travel disruption across parts of north-west England, after a power cut hit the signalling centre controlling the region . The power failure, which occurred shortly before 2pm on Thursday, temporarily halted trains and caused widespread cancellations and delays to services including CrossCountry and London Northwestern Railway.
